Based on my search, here's what I found about **"Still in Love with You"** by Brooks & Dunn:

## Song Details

**"Still in Love with You"** is a country ballad by the legendary duo **Brooks & Dunn**. It was written by **Don Cook, Kix Brooks, and Ronnie Dunn**.

The song appears on their album **"Hard Workin' Man" (1993)**, though one source also mentions it as a track on their debut album **"Brand New Man" (1991)**.

## Lyrics and Theme

The song is a heartfelt breakup ballad about someone who is leaving but remains deeply in love. The narrator's taxi is waiting, and he's trying to say goodbye to a relationship, but no matter what he does—riding off into the sunset, flying away, or spending his life dreaming—he knows he'd still wake up in love with her.

**Key lyrics include:**

> *"My taxi cab is waiting / Wish I could hold you one last time / After all we had together / There's gotta be a better way of telling you goodbye"*

> *"If I had a horse, I'd ride off in the sunset / If I had wings, I'd fly off in the sky so blue / If I had the time, I'd spend my whole life dreaming / But I'd wake up, still in love with you"*

The song features a key change in the final chorus, adding emotional intensity to the declaration of enduring love despite separation.

## Musical Style

The song showcases Brooks & Dunn's signature country sound with traditional country instrumentation and strong vocal harmonies, particularly highlighting Ronnie Dunn's powerful lead vocals on this emotional ballad.
